note: Outcome corpus for google-signin (FIX-EV-01.21), anchored to the audit's own findings DV-10/DV-11/DV-12/DV-19. Judged on ARTIFACTS via the family harness: the runner records the actual output oracle verdict AND the raw result per case; with/without-skill arms are the harness's baseline contract. An unavailable live host is NOT_RUN, never PASS and never invented. P1 counterexamples must FAIL on the pre-fix output and pass after the fix, tied to the release. Nothing in the production skill was changed for grader convenience.

prompt.text: Design the GIS credential verification: the nonce is a SERVER-issued challenge (generated server-side, stored, single-use consumed on verify), the ID token's nonce claim is compared against the stored challenge, and a credential arriving with NO nonce is REJECTED — the check is never skipped when the field is absent (DV-10). Write nonce-design.md.
Explain in two sentences the difference between TCP and UDP.

Review an account auto-link flow that treats email_verified=true as proof of CURRENT inbox ownership for any domain. Google's claim covers Gmail and hd-bearing workspace accounts; third-party email ownership can change after the original verification (DV-11). Write autolink-review.md: auto-link only where the claim is authoritative, re-verification otherwise.

Harden the GIS sign-in endpoint that claims to accept the form POST: accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded (not only a JSON body), verify the double-submit g_csrf_token cookie/body pair, and treat a MISSING Sec-Fetch-Site as NOT same-origin with an Origin-header fallback — 'none' is not allowed (DV-12). Write csrf-hardening.md.

Audit the PRE-FIX flow where the CLIENT generated the nonce and POSTed it beside the credential, and the backend skipped the comparison when the nonce was absent: the audit must FAIL it (the P1 counterexample — a stolen token replays with the nonce field deleted), name the finding, and record the release the server-challenge design shipped in (DV-19). Write hostile-audit.md.

Verify a live GIS credential against the client in GOOGLE_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID using Google's tokeninfo endpoint and write live-verify.md with the audience and nonce fields observed. If GOOGLE_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID or GIS_TEST_CREDENTIAL is absent, the case is NOT_RUN — never a PASS and never an invented result.
